target.title: refactor(config): declarative doctor alias-migration DSL with inheritance-aware account seeding
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Every channel doctor contract hand-writes the same four pieces for legacy alias migration: a `hasLegacy<Channel>StreamingAliases` matcher, two `legacyConfigRules` entries with long hand-maintained message strings, `resolveStreamingOptions` wiring, and the `normalizeCompatibilityConfig` plumbing that extracts/reassembles `channels.<id>`. Five channels carry copies today, and the upcoming six-channel nested-streaming batch (whatsapp/googlechat/mattermost/irc/signal/nextcloud-talk) would add six more.

Separately, `openclaw doctor --fix` had a migration-fidelity gap: when it materializes an ACCOUNT `streaming` object from flat delivery aliases on a channel whose runtime account merge replaces the root object wholesale (Discord — `streaming` is not in `mergeDiscordAccountConfig`'s `nestedObjectKeys`), the account silently stops inheriting root streaming subfields (`block.coalesce`, `chunkMode`, …) after the fix.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **`defineChannelAliasMigration(spec)`** (`src/config/channel-alias-migration.ts`, exported via `openclaw/plugin-sdk/runtime-doctor`): one declarative spec per channel generates the detection rules (root + accounts, standardized messages enumerating exactly the keys the spec accepts), the matcher, and the full `normalizeChannelConfig` migration. All five migrated channels (discord, telegram, slack, imessage, msteams) now declare specs; per-channel contracts shrink by net −146 lines and the six-channel batch lands as six small declarations.
- **Inheritance seeding, opt-in by merge semantics**: `normalizeLegacyChannelAliases` gains `seedAccountStreamingFromRoot` (DSL: `accountStreamingReplacesRoot`). For wholesale-replace channels (Discord opts in), doctor seeds materialized account objects with the inherited root settings and says so in the change list. Deep-merge channels (Slack via `mergeSlackStreamingConfig`, iMessage via `mergeIMessageStreamingConfig`) must NOT seed — their runtime keeps composing root+account, and copies would freeze inheritance — so they stay unseeded. The account mode-pinning truth table is enforced by tests: root absent → pin the channel's absent-object default; root object with mode → seed carries it (replace channels) / runtime merge supplies it (deep channels); root object without mode → never pin.
- **Dead option deleted**: `offModeLegacyNotice` had zero production callers (only a test passed it) and appears in no release tag (`v2026.7.1-beta.5` contains zero occurrences), so it is removed rather than carried.

## User Impact

- `openclaw doctor --fix` on Discord multi-account configs now preserves inherited root streaming settings (previously the account lost e.g. root `block.coalesce` after migration) and reports the copy explicitly.
- Doctor detection messages are standardized; telegram/slack rules gain the `Run "openclaw doctor --fix".` suffix, and msteams gains a previously missing accounts-level detection rule matching a migration it already performed.
- No other behavior changes; this is otherwise an internal consolidation.

## Evidence

- Testbox (Blacksmith, Linux Node 24): suites `src/config src/commands src/plugin-sdk extensions/{discord,telegram,slack,imessage,msteams}` green + full remote `check:changed` green with `set -o pipefail` (leases `tbx_01kxbpmq3zvkvsjp7t9b26ppss`, `tbx_01kxbrz6zq0t1598rvgexc1cc5`, `tbx_01kxbvkg2zzrs99g8fhczw8hx0`; final combined run exit 0).
- Autoreview (codex gpt-5.6-sol xhigh), three rounds: round 1 caught that unconditional seeding breaks deep-merge channels (fixed via the opt-in + per-channel verification of merge semantics); round 2 caught a stale iMessage test expecting seeding (fixed — account object stays account-local); round 3's only finding (keep `offModeLegacyNotice` for SDK compat) is rejected with evidence: the option is absent from every release tag, so per repo policy ("shipped = reachable from a release tag"; compatibility is opt-in) there is no contract to preserve.
- SDK surface pins re-verified by symbol delta: exactly `defineChannelAliasMigration`, `ChannelAliasMigrationSpec`, `StreamingAliasMode` added (+3 exports, +1 callable); plugin-sdk API baseline regenerated.
- LOC: per-channel doctor code −253/+107; the DSL module (+190 incl. docs) is smaller than the deletions it replaces, before the six-channel batch multiplies the payoff.

Prepares the six-channel nested-streaming batch (same release train as #104693/#105054). Refs #104693, #105054.
